Hey Erik, regarding METRICORE-107 edge cases for `moving_average`: the design review decided to use 'truncate' behavior for partial windows at the start (output fewer points) rather than padding with zeros or NaNs. We also agreed that `min_periods=1` is the default, so a window of size N with only 1 data point yields that point. Let me know if you need the full minutes.

Hi @vera, the ticket mentions you have design review notes for percent_change edge cases. The acceptance test expects percent_change(-50, -25) == 50.0, but my implementation gives -50.0 using the standard formula ((new-old)/old)*100. Is there a special convention for negative baselines we agreed on?

Design review agreed on the 'inclusive' rank (numpy/Excel PERCENTILE.INC): h=(n-1)*p/100, linear interp between s[floor(h)] and s[floor(h)+1]. So percentile([1..10],90)=9.1. test_interpolated_ranks is right; test_regression_issue_341 (9.9) is the stale one.
